item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 24/Jan/2026
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
An easterly airstream will affect the coast of Guangdong in the next couple of days. It will become cloudier gradually over the region, and relatively humid in the morning and at night. Under the influence of the northeast monsoon, it will be brighter over Guangdong midweek next week. A broad band of clouds is expected to cover southern China in the latter part of next week. A replenishment of the monsoon will affect the region over the next weekend.
